name: resolvenest
description: AI-powered customer support ticket management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
